name: Price Value Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies a type of value of the price.

DISC.name: Discount
DISC.definition: Price expressed as a number of percentage points below par, for example, a discount price of 2.0% equals a price of 98 when par is 100.

PREM.name: Premium
PREM.definition: Price expressed as a number of percentage points above par, for example, a premium price of 2.0% equals a price of 102 when par is 100.
